# mxroute_domain (Data Source)

Look up a domain and its mail hosting, SSL status and pointer summary. Mock-tested alpha; runtime API behavior remains live-unverified.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mxroute_domain" "example" {
  domain = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain` (String) Canonical owned domain name.

### Read-Only

- `mail_hosting` (Boolean)
- `pointers` (Set of String)
- `ssl_enabled` (Boolean)
